map.由数值序列求样本方差: Sample Variance from a Series of Values
map.输入多个数值（逗号或空格分隔），求样本方差。: Enter several values (separated by commas or spaces) to get the sample variance.
map.📖 查看「由数值序列求样本方差使用指南」: 📖 View the "Sample Variance from a Series of Values User Guide"
map.样本方差分母为 n−1（无偏）。: Sample variance uses the denominator n−1 (unbiased).
map.方差为何平方？: Why does variance square the deviations?
map.消除偏差正负抵消、惩罚离群，但量纲变为原单位平方，故常开方回标准差。: Squaring stops positive and negative deviations cancelling out and penalizes outliers, but it also squares the units, which is why the root is usually taken to return to the standard deviation.
map.请另用总体方差工具。: please use the population variance tool instead.
map.样本方差（本页代码口径，数据按空格/逗号分隔）：均值 x̄=Σx÷n；离差平方和: Sample variance (as coded on this page; data separated by spaces or commas): mean x̄=Σx÷n; sum of squared deviations=Σ(x−x̄)²; sample variance s²=sum of squared deviations÷(n−1) (unbiased estimate). Validation: no strict validation; with n<2 division by 0 yields NaN and the page shows "—". Criteria: no fixed grading; s² is always non-negative and is the square of the standard deviation; it is undefined with n=1.
